_comment: Beschreibungen je Quellordner. DE aus dem Vorgängerprojekt bzw. den EXPO-REAL-Briefings, EN übersetzt. Materialien nur, wo sie dokumentiert sind.

133.de: Ein L-förmiger Holzrahmen fasst den Stand an Rück- und Linksseite. Oben liegt eine Besprechungsterrasse unter einem schlanken, bepflanzten Dach, die Treppe läuft an der linken Wand. Sichtbare Holzstützen, viel Grün, warmes Licht.
133.en: An L-shaped timber frame wraps the rear and left side. Upstairs, a meeting terrace sits beneath a slim planted canopy, with the staircase running along the left wall. Exposed timber columns, plenty of greenery, warm light.
133.materialsEn: Glulam beams, oak slats, clear glass balustrades, planters
133.coloursEn: Natural oak, forest green, warm white

134.de: Eine gerundete Galeriekante kragt aus dem L-förmigen Baukörper hinten links aus. Darunter eine geschwungene Empfangstheke und über der Lounge eine ovale Deckenöffnung. Mineralische Flächen, Champagner-Metall, gebogenes Glas.
134.en: A rounded mezzanine edge projects from the L-shaped volume at the rear left. Below sits a curved reception counter, with an oval ceiling opening above the ground-floor lounge. Mineral surfaces, champagne metal, curved glass.
134.materialsDe: Glatte Mineralflächen, Champagner-Metall, gebogenes Glas, cremefarbene Polster
134.materialsEn: Smooth mineral surfaces, champagne metal, curved glass, cream upholstery

135.de: Ein kantig gefaltetes Dach und eine facettierte Obergeschossblende ergeben eine Origami-Silhouette auf einem Stahltragwerk. Die Ecke hinten links ist geschlossen, innen führt eine diagonale Treppe nach oben.
135.en: An angular folded canopy and a faceted upper-floor fascia form an origami silhouette on a structural steel frame. The rear-left corner is closed, with a diagonal stair leading up inside.
135.materialsDe: Gefaltete Paneele in Kupferoptik, dunkler Stahl, Terrazzo, Glas
135.materialsEn: Folded copper-look metal panels, dark steel, terrazzo, glass

136.de: Eine hohe Lamellenwand hinten links überragt ein streng horizontales Obergeschoss. Violettes Licht liegt in den Fugen, schlanke Stahlstützen lassen Front und rechte Gangseite offen.
136.en: A tall fin screen at the rear left rises above a sharply horizontal mezzanine. Violet light sits in the recesses, and slim steel columns keep the front and right aisle edges open.
136.materialsDe: Schwarzer Stahl, schmale Metalllamellen, transluzentes Glas, Boden in dunkler Steinoptik
136.materialsEn: Black steel, narrow metal fins, translucent glass, dark stone-effect flooring

137.de: Ein zweigeschossiger Pavillon hinten links mit gestaffelten Terrassen und begrünten Balkonen. Die Blende springt in Stufen statt als geschlossene Box, die Treppe liegt innen an der Rückwand.
137.en: A two-storey pavilion at the rear left with staggered upper terraces and planted balcony setbacks. The fascia steps back rather than forming a closed box, with the stair inside along the rear wall.
137.materialsDe: Bronzegewebe, heller Naturstein, Eiche, viel Bepflanzung
137.materialsEn: Bronze mesh, pale stone, oak, abundant planting

138.de: Ein trapezförmiger Besprechungsraum im Obergeschoss lehnt an Rück- und Linkswand. Tiefe Portalöffnungen gliedern das Innere, ein Balkon kragt versetzt auf sichtbar tragenden Stützen aus.
138.en: A trapezoidal upper meeting volume is anchored to the rear and left walls. Deep rectangular portals structure the interior, and an offset cantilevered balcony rests on visibly credible supports.
138.materialsDe: Leichte Paneele in Betonoptik, schwarzer Stahl, orangefarbener Akustikfilz, Klarglas
138.materialsEn: Lightweight concrete-look panels, black steel, orange acoustic felt, clear glass
138.coloursEn: Light concrete grey, burnt orange, black

139.de: Schlanke blaue Säulen im Takt tragen eine Galerie im Obergeschoss. Die Wände hinten links sind kanneliert, der Balkon wirkt leicht und offen. Die Säulen stehen innerhalb der Fläche, die Gangseiten bleiben frei.
139.en: Rhythmic slender blue columns carry an upper gallery. The rear-left walls are fluted and the balcony feels light and open. The columns stand inside the footprint, leaving the aisle edges free.
139.materialsDe: Kobaltblau lackierter Stahl, kannelierte Wandpaneele, Esche, satiniertes Glas
139.materialsEn: Cobalt-painted steel, fluted wall panels, ash wood, frosted glass

140.de: Große, weich gerundete Bögen sind in Rück- und Linkswand des Pavillons eingelassen. Oben liegt eine Lounge hinter einem offenen Bogenbalkon, die Treppe sitzt in der Ecke hinten links.
140.en: Large, softly rounded arches are set into the rear and left pavilion walls. An upper lounge sits behind an open arched balcony, with the stair tucked into the rear-left corner.
140.materialsDe: Putz in Terrakotta, Holz, geflochtene Akustikpaneele, Bronzegeländer
140.materialsEn: Terracotta-coloured plaster, timber, woven acoustic panels, bronze railings

141.de: Eine schlanke, hinterleuchtete Landmarke hinten links verbindet sich mit einem kompakten Obergeschoss. Transluzente Brüstung, leichter Silberrahmen, heller Terrazzo.
141.en: A slender illuminated landmark panel at the rear left merges with a compact two-storey mezzanine. Translucent balustrade, lightweight silver frame, white terrazzo.
141.materialsDe: Hinterleuchtete transluzente Paneele, Aluminium, Klarglas, weißer Terrazzo
141.materialsEn: Backlit translucent panels, aluminium, clear glass, white terrazzo
141.coloursEn: Opal white, icy cyan, brushed silver

142.de: Ein ausdrucksstarkes Diagonaltragwerk an Rück- und Linksseite gibt dem Stand seine Silhouette. Der Balkon ist kantig, die sichtbaren Streben bleiben Teil der Gestaltung, Front und rechte Seite sind offen.
142.en: An expressive diagonal structural frame along the rear and left boundaries defines the silhouette. The balcony is angular, the visible bracing is part of the design, and the front and right remain open.
142.materialsDe: Smaragdgrüne Stahlstreben, Eichenpaneele, Glas, begrünte Wände
142.materialsEn: Emerald steel diagonal braces, oak panels, glass, planted walls

143.de: Ein fächerförmiges Besprechungsdeck kragt aus einem Servicekern an der Rückwand aus, darüber radiale Dachrippen. Das Erdgeschoss bleibt offen, nur die Rückseite ist geschlossen.
143.en: A fan-shaped upper meeting deck projects from a rear service spine, topped by radial canopy ribs. The ground floor stays open and only the rear boundary is closed.
143.materialsDe: Radiale Holzrippen, weißer Stahl, Textilien in Koralle, Klarglas
143.materialsEn: Radial timber ribs, white steel, coral textiles, clear glass

144.de: Ein durchlaufendes, geschwungenes Band umfasst die Kante einer langen Brücke im Obergeschoss. Zwei skulpturale Stützen und ein Kern an der Rückwand tragen, drei Gangseiten bleiben offen.
144.en: A continuous sinuous ribbon wraps the edge of an elongated upper bridge deck. Two sculpted columns and a rear support spine carry the load, with three aisle sides left open.
144.materialsDe: Gebogene Metallblende in Marineblau, Messingakzente, Eiche, Glas
144.materialsEn: Navy curved metal fascia, brass accents, oak, glass

145.de: Eine kompakte Plattform an der Rückwand mit sichtbaren roten Querträgern und einem schwebenden, rechteckigen Dach. Front, linke und rechte Seite sind großzügig offen.
145.en: A compact rear-anchored upper platform with exposed red crossbeams and a floating rectangular canopy. Generous open entrances at the front, left and right.
145.materialsDe: Rot pulverbeschichteter Stahl, weiße Akustikpaneele, schwarzes Gewebe, Boden in Betonoptik
145.materialsEn: Red powder-coated steel, white acoustic panels, black mesh, polished concrete-look floor

146.de: Ein kreisrundes Lounge-Deck auf vier schlanken Stützen, über einen kurzen Steg mit der Rückwand verbunden. Darüber eine ringförmige Decke, alle drei Gangseiten sind offen.
146.en: A circular upper lounge deck on four slender columns, linked to the rear wall by a short elevated walkway. A ring-shaped ceiling above, with all three aisle sides open.
146.materialsDe: Gebogenes Glas, weißer Stahl, Polster in Pflaume, heller Terrazzo
146.materialsEn: Curved glass, white steel, plum upholstery, pale terrazzo

147.de: Ein Pavillon an der Rückseite aus gestaffelten Holzdachplatten. Die Terrasse im Obergeschoss kragt über die offene Empfangslounge aus, eine skulpturale Treppe läuft an der Rückwand, drei Seiten sind offen.
147.en: A rear pavilion built from staggered timber roof plates. The upper terrace projects over an open reception lounge, a sculptural stair runs along the rear wall, and three sides are open.
147.materialsDe: Paneele in Brettsperrholzoptik, grüne Textilien, Glas, recycelter Filz
147.materialsEn: Cross-laminated timber-look panels, green textiles, glass, recycled felt

148.de: Ein schräges, polygonales Dach über einem asymmetrischen Besprechungsdeck, getragen von einem kräftigen Diagonalrahmen an der Rückseite. Die Seiten bleiben ohne Wandrückläufe offen.
148.en: A sloping polygonal roof above an asymmetrical upper meeting deck, carried by a bold diagonal rear frame. The sides stay open with no boundary wall returns.
148.materialsDe: Schwarzer Baustahl, gelbes Aluminium, Lochblechpaneele, Glas
148.materialsEn: Black structural steel, yellow aluminium, perforated panels, glass

149.de: Ein sich verjüngender Pavillon im Obergeschoss mit sanft ausgestelltem Gewebedach und sichtbarem Balkon. Das Erdgeschoss ist transparent, Nebenräume liegen nur im Kern an der Rückseite.
149.en: A tapered upper pavilion with a gently flared mesh canopy and a visible elevated balcony. The lower structure is transparent, with service rooms confined to the rear spine.
149.materialsDe: Feines weißes Metallgewebe, transluzente Paneele in Mint, silberner Stahl, Esche
149.materialsEn: Fine white metal mesh, translucent mint panels, silver steel, ash timber

150.de: Eine Ziegelarkade nur an der Rückseite trägt eine industrielle Galerie. Petrolfarbene Stahlträger reichen über den Bewirtungsbereich im Erdgeschoss, links und rechts gibt es keine Wände.
150.en: A rear-only brick arcade carries an industrial upper gallery. Teal steel beams extend over the ground-floor hospitality area, with no left or right boundary walls.
150.materialsDe: Leichte Ziegelriemchen, petrolfarbener Stahl, Eiche, Klarglas
150.materialsEn: Lightweight brick slips, teal steel, oak, clear glass

151.de: Ein dreieckig facettiertes Deck mit gefaltetem Silberdach, verankert an einem Kern in der Mitte der Rückseite. Kantige Stützen tragen das Deck, an allen drei Gangseiten ist der Stand frei begehbar.
151.en: A triangular faceted upper deck with a folded silver roof anchored to a rear central core. Angular columns support the deck, with open circulation along all three aisle sides.
151.materialsDe: Facettierte Aluminiumpaneele, Flächen in dunkelblauer Glasoptik, Stahl, Podeste in weißer Steinoptik
151.materialsEn: Faceted aluminium panels, navy glass-effect surfaces, steel, white stone-effect plinths

152.de: Ein breites Obergeschoss unter einem sanft gewellten Dach aus goldenen Lamellen. Ein asymmetrischer Pavillon hinten trägt mit schlanken ovalen Stützen, darunter ein großzügiger, offener Salon.
152.en: A broad upper mezzanine beneath a gently undulating gold fin canopy. An asymmetric rear pavilion and slim oval columns carry it, above a spacious open ground-floor salon.
152.materialsDe: Goldene Vertikallamellen, Textilien in Aubergine, cremefarbene Mineralpaneele, gebogenes Glas
152.materialsEn: Gold vertical fins, aubergine textiles, cream mineral panels, curved glass

01 Lamello.de: Warmes Holz, Lamellen und eine LED-Wand in Marmoroptik. Ein offener Eckstand mit Theke, Lounge und Besprechungsinsel – kompakt, aber mit viel Atmosphäre.
01 Lamello.en: Warm wood, slats and an LED wall in a marble look. An open corner stand with counter, lounge and meeting island – compact, yet full of atmosphere.

02 Naturraum.en: Light wood, hanging greenery and a moss panel as an accent. A wraparound fascia carries the logo, with a two-by-two-metre storeroom behind the counter.

03 Monolith.en: Anthracite, dark marble and warm lines of light along every edge. Ring lights above the lounge, a closed back and clear, heavy forms.

04 Fluid.en: White, organic, floating: an oval ceiling element on curved supports, with an LED wall, a round reception counter and a circular lounge beneath.

05 Gartenforum.en: A timber pergola, an olive tree at the centre, a sage-green brand wall and terracotta seating islands. A stand that feels like a courtyard.

07 Rasterwerk.en: A black steel grid with floating acoustic sails in signal yellow. Perforated panels, an LED wall with golden veins of light and plenty of green – loud, graphic, industrial.

08 Lichtsegel.en: Two tensioned fabric sails above white supports, with a round counter, dove-blue armchairs and olive trees below. Light, bright and calm – like a Mediterranean courtyard.

09 Kupferbogen.en: Staggered portals in brushed copper with warm light edges. Behind them a long bar, burgundy velvet armchairs and smoked-glass pendant lights.

10 Prismenfeld.en: Folded surfaces of multiwall sheets that glow from within, with cobalt-blue triangles as brand carriers. A crystalline stand with a prism-shaped counter.

12 Basalttor.en: A massive basalt-textured frame with a light joint, holding a dark cube with an illuminated logo. Brass counter, bouclé armchairs, dramatic grazing light.

13 Geflechtinseln.en: Curved walls of rattan weave, backlit like lampshades. Olive-green cushions, terracotta, a light counter and oval logo signs – warm and crafted.

14 Aluminium-Orbit.en: A huge aluminium ring floats above an anthracite brand tower. A round stainless-steel counter, orange armchairs and screen steles – everything revolves around the centre.

15 Akustik-Kapseln.en: Round meeting pods in dark blue acoustic fabric, glass light columns and a white ribbed counter. Quiet space for conversation in the middle of the hall.

16 Roter Boulevard.en: A sequence of red frames with light edges draws the eye deep into the stand. Red counter, velvet sofas and a long table with a gallery on the wall.

17 Korklandschaft.en: Curved cork walls, a round tower at the centre and olive-green niches. Natural, acoustically pleasant and warmly lit.

18 Stahlwerft.en: A portal of blue-painted steel girders, a perforated metal ceiling and an industrial photo on the wall. Leather, a workbench counter and amber glass.

19 Glasatelier.en: A glass meeting room of ribbed glass, a dark blue brand tower and a brushed-aluminium counter. Clear, cool and precise.

22 Indigo-Labor.en: A frame in strong cobalt blue with backlit frosted glass and lab shelving behind. Stainless-steel demo counters, round meeting tables and a blue technology cube – clear, precise, technical.

24 Bambusfaltung.en: A roof of timber slats, folded like paper, on black supports. Beneath it a long wooden counter, forest-green niches and a bright lounge with olive trees.

25 Brueckenforum.en: A two-storey stand with an open staircase: demo tables in front of an LED wall downstairs, a gallery with a burgundy lounge, timber ceiling and glass balustrade upstairs.

26 Terrazzo-Atoll.en: A curved terrazzo wall, a round terracotta counter and a planted island at the centre. Pink-beige floor islands guide visitors through lounge and presentation – soft, sunny, Mediterranean.

28 Pixel-Wolke.en: Glowing cubes hover above the stand like a cloud of pixels. Black walls with yellow light pixels, a yellow reception counter and three demo steles – loud, digital, playful.

29 Saegezahn-Loft.en: A loft with a sawtooth roof and skylights: reception, demo table and two meeting rooms downstairs, a work and lounge deck with long wooden tables and leather sofas upstairs.

30 Chrom-Welle.en: A tall, undulating wall of polished metal spans the rear. In front, a violet counter, round presentation tables and a velvet lounge – glossy and elegant.

31 Myzel-Duenen.en: Organic white forms that look grown: dune walls with arches, a long curved presentation island and mustard-yellow lounges on a mint floor.

32 Panorama-Deck.en: A large two-storey presence with a dark brand tower, LED walls and two staircases. Reception and demo islands downstairs, a wraparound deck with lounge and bar upstairs.

34 Haengegarten.en: Plant baskets and tendrils hang from a black steel frame like a canopy of leaves. Beneath it soft pebble sofas, triangular info steles and a dark brand wall with timber slats.

36 Bibliotheksbruecke.en: Bookshelves up to the ceiling and a gallery with glass balustrade and lounge. Downstairs, reading tables with green banker's lamps and a counter of timber slats.

38 Akkordeon.en: A folded rear wall like the bellows of an accordion, in brass and graphite and backlit. In front, a long bench, a round meeting table and a black counter.

39 Steinrondell.en: Massive pillars in pale rubble-stone look stand in a circle around a yellow brand cube. A natural-stone reception, a lounge with grey armchairs and display islands between the columns.

40 Schwebende Scheibe.en: An oval ceiling disc with a band of light floats on black supports. Stainless-steel demo counters in front of a marble-look LED wall downstairs, a lounge with aubergine velvet armchairs upstairs.

42 Terrakottawabe.en: Hexagonal towers of terracotta lattice bricks hold storage, meeting room and display. Between them a lounge with bouclé armchairs and a sage-green counter.

43 Lichtschlucht.en: Two white wall panels with slanted edges open up a passage, their light joints glowing neon yellow. A dark glossy floor, a long meeting table and two reception counters.

44 Treppenforum.en: Orange seating steps form a forum for talks, a blue staircase leads upstairs to a lounge behind glass. Above it a white cube with a large logo.

45 Doppelgiebel.en: Two gables of light wood stand side by side like houses, linked by a gallery with glass balustrade. Café, lounge and meeting space downstairs, an open deck upstairs.

46 Faecherkrone.en: Timber slats fan out from a black central column like a treetop. Beneath it a wooden counter, round lounge sofas and a black brand wall.

49 Bogenloggia.en: Round arches like an Italian loggia, in two rows one above the other. A counter in front of a marble wall and café tables downstairs, a gallery with glass balustrade upstairs.

51 Spiegelportal.en: Portals of polished stainless steel mirror the hall and frame the view into the stand. A red carpet, a black meeting table, a white counter and display cases.

52 Lamelleninsel.en: An oval ring of timber slats floats above the island. Beneath it two counters, a marble wall with logo and a lounge with sage-green sofas.

53 Zwillingsdecks.en: Two navy steel cubes, each with its own stair, carry a deck, with an LED wall showing a mountain scene in between. Reception, demo and lounge downstairs, long work tables upstairs.

55 Containerterrasse.en: Stacked shipping containers with orange frames and a planted facade. Reception, demo and meeting tables downstairs, a terrace with timber deck and café tables upstairs.

56 Lichtzylinder.en: Five staggered cylinders glowing from within run diagonally across the space. In front, a stainless-steel counter, an olive-green lounge and a long meeting table; at the back a two-by-two-metre storeroom.

58 Ziegelpassage.en: Two perforated brick walls cut diagonally through the stand and form a passage. Reception and a lounge with bouclé armchairs at the front, a meeting table and a small storeroom behind – warm, crafted, open.

59 Drehbuehne.en: At the centre, a round stage five metres across beneath a glowing ring arch. Around it reception, lounge and a six-seat bar in white and royal blue – made for presentations.

60 Cortenschlucht.en: Two tall walls of Corten steel form a canyon with a passage from front to back. Lit wall niches display exhibits, with a long table, a leather bench and a white counter.

61 Kreuzgrat-Pavillon.en: A white pavilion of four groin vaults resting on slender columns at the corners. Beneath it a round burgundy counter, lounges and standing tables – light, bright and festive.

64 Fachwerkloggia.en: A sturdy timber framework carries an upper-floor loggia. Reception, café counter and lounge downstairs, a meeting deck beneath timber beams overlooking the hall upstairs.

69 Terrassenkaskade.en: Shipping containers carry a planted roof terrace with parasols and a lounge. Downstairs a long wooden counter, display cases and screens across 324 m².

70 Amphitheater.en: Semicircular seating steps in front of a large LED wall turn the stand into a stage. Above it a terrace beneath a pergola, carried by dark containers.

71 Snow Lab.en: A winter sports stand with a mountain panorama on the walls, a row of snowboards and shelves of boots. A dark blue fascia with logo above, a counter and a meeting table in front.

72 Hafenpassage.en: Two navy containers form an alley like in a harbour. Upstairs two terraces with parasols and a lounge, reception and meeting space below.

76 Skybridge.en: Two container towers in white and anthracite, linked by an orange steel bridge with logo. Lounge and meeting space among plants downstairs, glazed meeting rooms and roof terraces upstairs.

77 Diagonal Dock.en: A timber boardwalk runs diagonally through the stand, with a deck beneath a pergola above. Dark containers with orange edges, an LED wall with a mountain scene and a wedge-shaped counter with a light edge.

79 Galerie-Spirale.en: Petrol-blue containers wrap like a spiral around a planted courtyard. Display cases for exhibits, a wooden counter at the front and a roof deck with parasols and lounge.

81 Campus.en: A white and a black container face each other like buildings on a campus. Between them a plaza with olive trees, work tables and a wooden counter, a terrace with parasols upstairs.

82 Gartenhof.en: Olive-green containers with planted roofs frame a courtyard with palms and round seating groups. Upstairs a timber terrace with lounge and a long counter.

83 Glashaus.en: A two-storey glass cube between light grey container walls with orange light edges. Reception and product plinths downstairs, a terrace with glass balustrade and lounge upstairs.

84 Doppelhof.en: Four container towers with orange frames form two courtyards one behind the other. Upstairs a glazed meeting deck between roof terraces with parasols, screens and standing tables below.

85 Alpine Gear.en: A compact outdoor stand with a mountain panorama and shelves full of jackets, backpacks and helmets. A black fascia with logo above, a white counter and a figure in ski gear in front.

88 Marktplatz.en: Four wood-look containers at the corners, with a counter beneath sun sails at the centre like a market square. Upstairs a lounge beneath a timber pergola.

89 Container-Ring.en: Forest-green containers with timber slats close into a ring around an open courtyard. Upstairs a wraparound deck with lounge, reached by a stair from the courtyard.

90 Pet Nutrition.en: A pet food stand with a large mural: a golden retriever in the grass. Wooden shelves with food bags, a ribbed wooden counter and a sage-green fascia above.

92 Auto Tech.en: Brake discs, an engine and rims on concrete plinths in front of a black wall with blue stripes. A fascia hangs from the truss above, a black counter stands in front.

94 Vision Lounge.en: Sunglasses in lit shelves and glass display cases, with large-format eyewear images. A black counter with a light edge and a small meeting table.

95 Seat Studio.en: Car seats in black, cognac and grey on plinths in front of a leather-look rear wall with decorative stitching. A shelf of leather samples at the side, a wooden counter in front.

96 Workshop Tech.en: Tool walls, red workshop trolleys and diagnostic equipment in front of a black wall with red diagonals. Plus a meeting table and a black counter.

97 Tyre Gallery.en: Summer, winter and all-season tyres on plinths, plus a cross-section. Rims on blue-lit shelves and a rear wall with a tyre tread and a mountain road.

99 Coffee Lab.en: A bean-to-cup machine, portafilter and grinder on a counter in front of a coffee bean mural. Lit shelves with coffee packs and a small bistro table.

100 Fitness Zone.en: Treadmill, weight bench and ergometer on dark sports flooring in front of a wall with a runner and neon-green paint splashes. A black counter and a meeting table.

101 Auto Light.en: Headlights and tail lights on white shelves, a wall in midnight blue and a large image of a headlight in the dark. A midnight-blue counter in front.

103 Camera Studio.en: Cameras and lenses on lit shelves and in a glass case, with a mountain lake at night as a mural behind. A tripod, two armchairs and a black counter.

106 Trail Footwear.en: Hiking boots on stones, tree stumps and lit shelves in front of a forest panorama. Wooden floor, an olive-green counter and plenty of greenery.

107 Clean Tech.en: Cordless vacuums and robot vacuums in front of white and turquoise walls. Shelves with accessories, a white counter and a round table.

108 Audio Lounge.en: Headphones on a lit wall board and in glass cases, with a large headphone against violet sound waves behind. A ribbed counter and violet bar stools.

110 Brecherpark.en: Jaw, impact and cone crushers stand in a row on the grounds, with rock samples and info boards in between. A black container building with logo and roof terrace, a pavilion next to it.

113 Pumpenparcours.en: Three truck-mounted concrete pumps with red placing booms, linked by a red delivery line. A visitor path leads from the pump to the pour point, with the terrace on top of the white container building.

117 Raupenfeld.en: Yellow bulldozers on gravel beds, with blades of every size and info steles. At the edge a grey container building with logo, roof terrace and lounge.

122 Kranfeld.en: Red tower cranes at different heights, with precast concrete elements and trusses in between. A red and white container building with logo, stair and terrace forms the meeting point.

124 Baggerpark.en: Excavators from mini to crawler in black and yellow, spread along a diagonal course with a sandbox. The black container building with logo sits at the top edge.

127 Hubbuehnenpark.en: Scissor and telescopic lifts in yellow and green, raised to different heights. The white container building with logo has a terrace, and a tent stands on the open area.
